parameters.help_en:
The start timestamp for querying alert history.

Unit: milliseconds.

You can only query the alert history of the last year.
The time interval between the start time (`StartTime`) and the end time (`EndTime`) must be less than or equal to 15 days

查询报警历史的开始时间戳。

parameters.help_en:
The alert level and notification method. Valid values:

<props="china">- P2: Phone call + text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- P3: Text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- P4: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- OK: No alert.</props>

<props="intl">- P4: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="intl">- OK: No alert.</props>

<props="partner">- P4: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="partner">- OK: No alert.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
报警的级别和通知方式。取值：

<props="china">- P2：电话+短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- P3：短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- OK：无报警。</props>

<props="intl">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="intl">- OK：无报警。</props>

<props="partner">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="partner">- OK：无报警。</props>
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
The alert status. Valid values:
0: An alert is triggered or the alert recovers to Normal.
1: Outside the effective period.
2: Mute epoch.
3: The host is restarting.
4: Does not send alert notifications.

<props="china">If the alert status is 0 and the value of Level is P2, P3, or P4, an alert is triggered. If the value of Level is OK, the alert recovers to Normal.</props>
<props="intl">If the alert status is 0 and the value of Level is P4, an alert is triggered. If the value of Level is OK, the alert recovers to Normal.</props>
<props="partner">If the alert status is 0 and the value of Level is P4, an alert is triggered. If the value of Level is OK, the alert recovers to Normal.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
报警状态。取值：
0：发生报警或报警恢复正常。
1：非生效期。
2：通道沉默周期。
3：主机重启中。
4：不发送报警。

<props="china">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P2、P3或P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
<props="intl">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
<props="partner">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
